column1: 1|1|第 makes ordinals; 小 can form familiar names; 们 marks a group of people. Put a place word after the reference noun: 桌子上, 学校外, 门前, 房间里, 楼下, 门后. 边 forms words such as 左边.|他是第一个到学校的人。|Tā shì dì yī ge dào xuéxiào de rén.|He is the first person to get to school.|书在桌子___。|上|先|第

1|2|Put a modal before the verb: 会 for learned ability, 能 for circumstances, 想 for desire, 要 for intention, 可以 for permission. A separable verb can split around an amount or aspect marker.|他会说中文。|Tā huì shuō Zhōngwén.|He can speak Chinese.|昨天晚上我睡___八个小时。|了|会|把

1|3|Question words stay where the answer belongs. 什么 asks what, 谁 who, 哪 which, 几 how many, 怎么 how. 我 and 你 identify people; 大家 refers to the group; 这 and 那 point, and 有些 means some.|你想买什么？|Nǐ xiǎng mǎi shénme?|What do you want to buy?|门口的那个人是___？|谁|几|怎么

1|4|Use 二 for a digit or ordinal and 两 before classifiers. A classifier goes between the number and noun, such as 两本书 or 三杯水. For duration use a measure such as 小时 after the number.|我看了两本书。|Wǒ kàn le liǎng běn shū.|I read two books.|我想买___杯茶。|两|第|第二

1|5|很 marks degree, 都 scope, 也 addition, 常 frequency, 在 and 正在 progress, 再 a later or repeated action, and 还 continuation. 不 negates usual actions or intention, 没 negates an event or existence, and 不要 tells someone not to do something.|我今天没喝咖啡。|Wǒ jīntiān méi hē kāfēi.|I did not drink coffee today.|我昨天___去学校，因为我病了。|没|再|都

1|6|Use 在 before the place. 对 introduces the target of an action or attitude. 和 can introduce a companion before a verb or join nouns of equal status.|我在家和姐姐吃饭。|Wǒ zài jiā hé jiějie chīfàn.|I eat at home with my older sister.|爸爸___朋友一起去医院。|和|吗|哪

1|7|的 follows a modifier, 了 signals a completed action or a change, 吗 makes a yes–no question, 吧 softens a suggestion, and 呢 can return a question or point to an ongoing situation. 啊 can express a reaction.|我们一起去吧！|Wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba!|Let’s go together.|这是妈妈___衣服。|的|吧|呢

1|8|Equal elements can coordinate; a modifier precedes its head; a verb can take an object; a subject can take a predicate. 数量 groups number and classifier, 在家 is prepositional, and 桌子上 is a place phrase.|红色的杯子在桌子上。|Hóngsè de bēizi zài zhuōzi shàng.|The red cup is on the table.|我想喝___。|茶|正在|上边

1|9|The subject introduces what the sentence is about; the predicate says something about it and a verb may take an object. Attributives precede nouns and adverbials usually precede the verb.|我今天在家看书。|Wǒ jīntiān zài jiā kàn shū.|I am reading at home today.|她___喝茶，不在家喝。|在学校|学校在|在的学校
1|10|Actions can be counted with 次 or 下 after the verb. 次 counts occurrences; 一下 is a brief action or a softened request.|请等一下。|Qǐng děng yíxià.|Please wait a moment.|这个电影我看了一___。|次|本|个

1|11|A predicate can be verbal, adjectival or nominal (for dates and ages). A short utterance can omit the subject. Choose the ending and word order for a statement, question, request or exclamation.|今天星期三。|Jīntiān xīngqīsān.|Today is Wednesday.|太好___！|了|吗|过

1|14|Place + 有 introduces something present, whereas place + 是 identifies what occupies that place. Serial verbs can express purpose. Certain verbs such as 给 or 教 can take a recipient and a thing.|他给我一本书。|Tā gěi wǒ yì běn shū.|He gives me a book.|我去商店___水果。|买|的|和

1|15|Clauses may be placed next to one another without a conjunction. Put 也 before another predicate to add similar information, or 还 to add another activity or fact.|我喜欢茶，也喜欢咖啡。|Wǒ xǐhuan chá, yě xǐhuan kāfēi.|I like tea, and I also like coffee.|她会说中文，___会说英语。|还|哪|刚才

1|16|Verb + 了 presents a completed event, as in 买了书. Sentence-final 了 marks a new situation, as in 天冷了. Context determines the reading when both positions coincide.|天冷了。|Tiān lěng le.|It has turned cold.|昨天我买___一本书。|了|呢|吗

1|17|在 or 正在 precedes the action as a progress marker. Sentence-final 呢 can mark the ongoing situation; 在 + place instead says where it happens.|他在看书呢。|Tā zài kàn shū ne.|He is reading right now.|妈妈___做饭呢。|正在|以前|过
1|18|Say dates in year–month–day order; say the hour before the minute. 第 marks order. State the amount of money before 块 or 元.|现在八点半。|Xiànzài bā diǎn bàn.|It is eight thirty now.|这本书二十___。|块|点|号

2|1|面 can turn a spatial root into a location word. 左面 and 右面 show sides; 上面 and 下面 show vertical position. Place the reference noun before it.|商店在学校右面。|Shāngdiàn zài xuéxiào yòumiàn.|The shop is to the right of the school.|鞋在桌子___。|下面|刚才|怎么

2|2|AA, A一A, A了A and ABAB can present trying or briefly doing an action. Adjective repetition such as 红红的 or 干干净净 highlights the quality. Do not apply every pattern to every verb.|你看一看这张照片。|Nǐ kàn yi kàn zhè zhāng zhàopiàn.|Take a look at this photo.|我们休息___吧。|休息|非常|个个

2|3|可能 before a verb or an entire prediction expresses uncertainty. Separable verbs permit an inserted marker or amount, for example 游了两次泳 or 跑了半个小时步.|他明天可能来。|Tā míngtiān kěnéng lái.|He might come tomorrow.|我昨天游了两次___。|泳|跑|步

2|4|为什么 asks why, 自己 refers back to oneself, 这么 and 那么 mark degree, 这样 and 那样 show manner, and 每 combines with a measure to mean each.|我每天自己做饭。|Wǒ měi tiān zìjǐ zuòfàn.|I cook for myself every day.|你___不去学校？因为我病了。|为什么|这么|自己

2|5|万 is ten thousand. 多 makes an approximate quantity. 条 counts long objects, 位 people politely, 间 rooms, 名 people in a role, 包 packages. 次 can count actions rather than objects.|她订了两间房。|Tā dìng le liǎng jiān fáng.|She booked two rooms.|请问那___老师叫什么名字？|位|条|包

2|6|最 marks the highest degree; 一起 marks shared activity; 已经 marks an attained state; 经常 indicates frequency; 别 prohibits; 再 signals repetition and 就 an early or immediate result; 还是 can signal a preferred alternative.|我的作业已经写完了。|Wǒ de zuòyè yǐjīng xiěwán le.|I have already finished my homework.|我们两个人___去看电影吧，一个人去没意思。|一起|最|从

2|7|从 marks a source, 给 a recipient, 比 a comparison, 跟 accompaniment, 因为 a reason. 虽然…但是… contrasts; 因为…所以… connects cause and result; 还是 offers alternatives.|因为下雨，所以我们没出去。|Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen méi chūqù.|Because it was raining, we did not go out.|___很累，但是他还在工作。|虽然|所以|比

2|8|Verb + 得 leads into a complement; modifier + 地 precedes the verb; modifier + 的 precedes a noun or stands for it. 呢, 吧, 的 and 啊 can also shape the utterance ending.|她高兴地笑了。|Tā gāoxìng de xiào le.|She laughed happily.|他说___很快。|得|地|了

2|9|Verb–complement phrases express a result; a 的 phrase can stand for a noun. Actions can form a chain or use a pivot such as 请他来. 还是…吧 suggests, 快要…了 signals imminence, 都…了 emphasizes how far things have gone, and 什么的 gives examples.|电影快要开始了。|Diànyǐng kuàiyào kāishǐ le.|The movie is about to start.|这本书是我买___。|的|得|地

2|10|The subject can name the affected object. Dates and ages can use nominal predicates. Put a verb phrase or subject–predicate phrase before 的 to modify a noun.|我昨天买的书很好看。|Wǒ zuótiān mǎi de shū hěn hǎokàn.|The book I bought yesterday is good.|这就是她昨天写___信。|的|得|地

2|11|Attach a result such as 完, 懂 or 错 after the verb. 来 moves toward the point of view and 去 away; combine with directions when needed. Use 得 for manner and add a time or count for duration or quantity.|老师走进来了。|Lǎoshī zǒu jìnlái le.|The teacher walked in.|这本书我还没有看___。|完|给|间

2|13|别 makes a negative command. 是 can explain or emphasize (是…的); 有 can state an attained amount. Place + verb + 着 describes a state. In 请他来, 他 is both recipient of 请 and actor of 来. 给 can introduce the receiver and the thing.|我是昨天来的。|Wǒ shì zuótiān lái de.|It was yesterday that I came.|天冷，___开窗户。|别|都|过

2|14|比 states a difference; use 有 or 没有…这么／那么 for reaching or falling short of a degree. A quantity can state the size of a difference, and comparison can also describe an action.|弟弟没有我这么高。|Dìdi méiyǒu wǒ zhème gāo.|My younger brother is not as tall as I am.|我哥哥比我大___。|两岁|很|都

2|15|还是 connects alternatives. 虽然…但是… signals contrast, 因为…所以… signals cause and result, 一…就… indicates immediate succession.|她一到家就做饭。|Tā yí dào jiā jiù zuòfàn.|As soon as she gets home, she cooks.|他一进门___给我打电话。|就|所以|虽然

2|17|Verb + 着 describes a continuing state or an action held in progress. In a place-first sentence, it can describe what is present there. Do not confuse 门开着 (open) with 门开了 (opened).|桌子上放着一本书。|Zhuōzi shàng fàngzhe yì běn shū.|There is a book lying on the table.|门开___，你可以进去。|着|过|得

2|19|Use an ordinal and classifier to identify a particular item, as in 第三本. 几 asks for a small amount. 数词＋多＋量词 can mean more than a round count; 数词＋量词＋多 can exceed a measured amount.|我们走了一个多小时。|Wǒmen zǒu le yí ge duō xiǎoshí.|We walked for over an hour.|他买了十___本书。|多|第|万

3|1|老 can form familiar names or lexical words. 家 and 员 form people or roles, and 子 forms some nouns. 东南西北 give directions, 中间 gives the middle; attach 边 or 面 where appropriate.|银行在学校东边。|Yínháng zài xuéxiào dōngbian.|The bank is east of the school.|公园在医院___边。|北|们|家

3|2|Use 需要 for need, 该 and 应该 for what is due or advisable, 愿意 for willingness, and 得 (děi) for necessity. Some verb–object and verb–complement units can separate, such as 见了两次面.|明天考试，我得早点儿睡。|Míngtiān kǎoshì, wǒ děi zǎodiǎnr shuì.|I have an exam tomorrow, so I must sleep early.|我跟她见过两次___。|面|了|得

3|3|怎样 asks manner. Question words with 都 can be unrestricted, as in 谁都知道; they can also be indefinite in context. 咱们 includes the listener, 别人 means other people, 别的 and 其他 point to alternatives.|你什么时候来都可以。|Nǐ shénme shíhou lái dōu kěyǐ.|You can come any time.|这是我的书，不是___的。|别人|怎样|咱们去

3|4|Choose a classifier by object, standard unit, container or action: 张, 公斤, 碗, 次. Repeated classifiers such as 张张 give distributive meaning (each item).|我买了两公斤苹果。|Wǒ mǎi le liǎng gōngjīn píngguǒ.|I bought two kilos of apples.|请给我一___面。|碗|张|次

3|5|更 increases degree; 只 restricts; 才 can show lateness or a condition; 一边 marks simultaneous actions, 终于 a long-awaited result, 必须 necessity and 不用 lack of necessity. Adverbs usually stand before the predicate.|我们等了很久，他终于来了。|Wǒmen děng le hěn jiǔ, tā zhōngyú lái le.|We waited a long time; he finally came.|已经有票了，___再买。|不用|必须|终于

3|6|为 and 为了 express purpose or benefit, 向 direction, 关于 topic, 根据 basis, 把 handling and 被 passive. Use 如果…的话 for a condition, 只有…才 for necessity, 只要…就 for sufficiency, and 不但…而且 for addition.|只要你有时间，就可以来。|Zhǐyào nǐ yǒu shíjiān, jiù kěyǐ lái.|As long as you have time, you can come.|___下雨的话，我们就不去了。|如果|而且|或

3|7|Apposition renames the same person; complements modify an action; quantities can repeat for distribution. 看来 marks inference, 看起来 appearance, 越来越 a growing trend, and 一般来说 a generalization. 不A不B correlates two negatives and 不一会儿 means before long.|天越来越冷了。|Tiān yuèláiyuè lěng le.|It is getting colder and colder.|___，这件衣服很适合你。|看起来|越来越|不一会儿了

3|8|除了 sets an exception or adds beyond it; 从…起 sets a starting point; 对…来说 gives a viewpoint; 一点儿也不 strengthens negation; 越…越 correlates changes. 以前／以后 set time, 该…了 says something is due, and 在…中 frames the setting.|对我来说，写汉字不容易。|Duì wǒ lái shuō, xiě Hànzì bù róngyì.|For me, writing Chinese characters is not easy.|越练习，___容易记住。|越|在|该

3|9|A verb, adjective, or clause can be the topic/subject, for example 学中文很有意思. Stack modifiers before a noun; choose their order to make the reference clear.|坐地铁很方便。|Zuò dìtiě hěn fāngbiàn.|Taking the metro is convenient.|___对身体好。|每天走路|身体的|身体上

3|10|Result complements include 到, 住, 走 and 上. Directions include 出, 起 and 下; extended forms like 起来 and 下去 can mark a beginning or continuation. Verb + duration + 了 can describe elapsed time up to now.|我在这儿住三年了。|Wǒ zài zhèr zhù sān nián le.|I have lived here for three years.|他把手机拿___了，我找不到。|走|次|好看

3|14|Put the known affected object after 把. The verb normally has a result, location or recipient: 放在桌上, 写完, 交给老师. Plain bare verbs in the 把 frame are usually incomplete.|她把书放在桌子上了。|Tā bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shàng le.|She put the book on the table.|请把这张纸交___老师。|给|着|次

3|17|Use 更 or 还 after the 比 reference for added degree, 不比 for a negative comparison and 跟…一样 for equality. 多、少、早、晚 may precede an action plus a measured difference.|他跟我一样高。|Tā gēn wǒ yíyàng gāo.|He is as tall as me.|今天我比昨天早到___。|十分钟|更|一样

3|18|Place-first clauses with a directional or result complement can introduce a new arrival or a disappearance. 是…的 can also stress an opinion or attitude when the context supplies the proposition.|门口走进来一个人。|Ménkǒu zǒu jìnlái yí ge rén.|Someone walked in at the door.|楼下___了两辆车。|开走|在|多少

3|19|然后 advances a sequence; 或者 offers alternatives; 一边…一边 pairs actions; 不但…而且 adds; 可是 contrasts. 如果 sets a hypothesis, 只要 sets a sufficient condition, 为了 gives purpose, and 越…越 links related change.|我一边做饭，一边听音乐。|Wǒ yìbiān zuòfàn, yìbiān tīng yīnyuè.|I listen to music while cooking.|___明天下雨，我们就坐地铁。|如果|而且|然后
